name: Vidhyadeep Yojana
benefit:
> ***Accidental Death***

₹50,000/- per student.
> ***Accidental Permanent Disability***

- In case of loss of two eyes or both limbs or arm/leg due to accident: ₹50,000/-.
- In case of loss of one eye and one limb due to accident: ₹50,000/-.
- In case of loss of one eye or one limb due to accident: ₹25,000/-.

_eligibility_text: > ***For the Student Beneficiary*** - The beneficiary must be a student studying in all Primary, Secondary, and Higher Secondary schools of Gujarat. > ***For the Applicant/Claimant*** - The applicant must be the successor or the disabled beneficiary themselves in case of permanent disability. - The applicant must appear in person with the original identity card. - The applicant must submit the written application in the prescribed format to the local Nodal/Competent Officer. - The application must be submitted within ninety (90) days from the date of death or accident.
